title: JPEGs Pay It Forward
tagline: Leveraging rivalries between NFT communities to see which can one-up the other to donate the most to Girls Who Code
description: This project allows users to donate to Girls Who Code. Cryptopunk holders can donated into one pool, holders of NFTs from the Bored Ape's ecosystem can donate into another, and the wider crypto community can donate into a third. Will the apes let the punks get away with donating the most money? Or will both of them fall short of what the wider community will donate?
how_its_made: This project uses scaffold-eth as its base. The smart contract plugs into the mainnet contracts for Cryptopunks and all of the Bored Ape ecosystem contracts to verify ownership. Ether is sent to a contract, counted, and immediately and trustlessly forwarded to a contract address set up by The Giving Block for Girls Who Code.
